name: Kichigai
source:
Parody game of ToHeart. 

Japan is occupied by China. Dark atmosphere engulfs everything. Main character struggles every day to survive in this chaotic world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《ToHeart》的恶搞作品。

日本被中国占领，阴暗的气氛笼罩了一切。主人公每天都在这个混乱的世界里挣扎求生。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
